_comment: The watchlist: the symbols the nightly backfill maintains. Add your own. Each entry needs a symbol; everything else is optional. con_id is filled in by 'cli.py universe --resolve' and is the only identifier a fetch trusts. A null con_id with a note means resolution failed and the entry is still watched. intervals lists what the backfill maintains; intraday bars stay fetch on demand. An optional 'case' field is free text for grouping, if you want one.
